channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🧘 Exercise Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Gentle daily movement coach for older adults with short balance, stretch, strength and walking routines.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 👓 Hearing & Vision Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Reads photographed mail, labels and forms back in large text or voice for older adults with poor sight or hearing.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ⛈️ Weather & Outage Alerts by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Watches weather and power outages for an older adult's area and sends plain alerts with safety steps.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📅 Social Calendar by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Keeps an older adult connected by finding nearby senior-center events, classes, clubs and volunteer spots each week.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📹 Video Call Connector by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Makes family video calls easy for an older adult with one-tap setup, a call schedule and reminders.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔧 Home Maintenance Reminder by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Seasonal home maintenance reminders for an older adult, plus vetted local repair pros and scam warnings.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🩺 Appointment Prep by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Preps an older adult for doctor visits with a one-page sheet, then turns notes into a plain-language summary.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧩 Reading & Puzzles Buddy by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Daily companion for an older adult with calm news summaries plus trivia, word games and memory puzzles.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🥗 Grocery & Meal Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Plans simple weekly meals for an older adult around diet, budget and taste, then builds the grocery list.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚗 Ride Finder by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Arranges rides for an older adult by comparing rideshare, senior transit, paratransit and volunteer drivers.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🐾 Pet Care Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps an older adult care for a pet with feeding, walk, vet and refill reminders, plus nearby sitters and vets.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧭 Benefits Finder by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps older adults find benefits they qualify for, like Medicare plans, Extra Help, SNAP and LIHEAP.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📱 Tech Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Patient tech helper that walks older adults through phone, TV, Wi-Fi and printer issues one step at a time.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🗄️ Estate & Documents Organizer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps a family organize an older adult's key documents: what exists, where it's kept, and who the agents are.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏠 Home Safety Audit by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Reviews photos of an older adult's home room by room and returns a prioritized fall-risk and safety checklist.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📦 Downsizing & Move Planner by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Plans a senior's downsizing or move: compares senior-living costs, builds a timeline and keep/sell/donate lists.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📖 Memory Book by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps an older adult record life stories one warm question at a time and turns them into a family keepsake.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧾 Bill & Paperwork Watch by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Watches an older adult's bills and mail for late bills, odd or duplicate charges, price hikes and renewals.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 👾 Game Sprite Designer by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Friendly game art mentor that helps beginners design original characters, items and places as game-ready sprites.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 💰 Chief Financial Officer by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Practical CFO for solo builders: one simple ledger, runway and AI tool spend tracking, and cost flags.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: ♟️ Chief Strategy Officer by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Strategy lead for solo builders and small teams: maps your work and picks up to 3 priorities for 90 days.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: ☀️ Daily Check-In by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Gentle daily check-in for an older adult on sleep, meals, meds and mood; alerts family if something's off.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔐 Child Safety Coach by Phillip Holland
item.description: Helps parents lock down a child's iPhone or Android and its AI apps, then rechecks settings don't revert.
item.dc:creator: Phillip Holland (@Phil_Holland)

item.title: 🌱 Usage Monitor Bot by Serenejay
item.description: A usage and speed advisor for people who run several Grok Bots. Audits your bots, cuts wasted usage and build time without losing quality, and can act as your head of bots.
item.dc:creator: Serenejay (@Serenejaysew)

item.title: 🛡️ Usage Guardian by Brandon by Brandon Barton
item.description: Watches your Grok Bot usage every night, forecasts your run-out date, catches runaway loops and spikes, checks big jobs before you start them, and trims wasteful routines in a weekly recap. Read-only unless you say OK.
item.dc:creator: Brandon Barton (@BrandonBarton26)

item.title: 🧑‍💻 CTO by Trond Eirik Haavarstein
item.description: A hands-on engineer for site and server migrations, hosting, DNS and deploys. Reads before it changes, asks before anything irreversible, and confirms every fix with a live check.
item.dc:creator: Trond Eirik Haavarstein (@xenappblog)

item.title: ⚖️ Legal Counsel by Trond Eirik Haavarstein
item.description: A research-and-drafting legal assistant for solo founders and small LLCs. Drafts contracts, vendor paperwork, privacy policies and terms, and tracks entity housekeeping and cross-border day counts. Never files, signs or sends without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Trond Eirik Haavarstein (@xenappblog)

item.title: 🛟 Hacked Account Recovery Helper by Z23 by ZyMoProfit
item.description: Walks you through each app's official recovery steps for a hacked or locked account (X, Facebook, Instagram, Gmail, Apple, Microsoft, WhatsApp, TikTok and more), then locks it down and helps you spot recovery scams. Never asks for passwords or codes.
item.dc:creator: ZyMoProfit (@ZyMoProfit)

item.title: 🧱 BrickSmith by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Snap a photo of your loose LEGO-style bricks spread out in one layer and get fun build ideas with kid-friendly step-by-step instructions. Not affiliated with the LEGO Group.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🖨️ PrintSmith by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Designs original 3D-printable items from plain-language ideas in free, open-source OpenSCAD, checks printability, and delivers color previews, ready-to-slice STL/3MF files, print-time estimates, and editable source.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🎨 Art Project Planner by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Helps visual artists turn an idea into a clear brief, concept images, a materials list, and a launch plan.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 🥕 Meal Planner by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Plans weekly meals around your pantry and budget, builds a priced, aisle-sorted grocery list, and reads food labels to suggest better swaps.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 📦 Kids Building and Craft Coach by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: A building and craft coach for kids aged 3 to 9 and a grown-up, turning cardboard, blocks, and play dough into short builds before sending kids off to play.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 🖍️ Kids Activities and Crafts Planner by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Helps parents, carers, and teachers plan age-right kids activities and crafts for every season, schedule them ahead, and track what is in the craft cupboard.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 🧺 Decluttering Coach by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: Turns messy bedrooms and playrooms into simple 10-minute tidy routines for kids, using the bins a family already owns before suggesting new ones.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 🗂️ Chief of Staff by Rachel by Rachel V
item.description: A budget-aware chief of staff for solo builders and small teams that runs projects in the background and adds lean specialist bots only when a role is clear.
item.dc:creator: Rachel V (@RachelVT42)

item.title: 🏘️ LeaseLord by Jonah by Jonah Anthony
item.description: A rental assistant for small landlords and self-managing property managers that tracks rent, renewals, maintenance, and screening.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: ⏱️ Stewart Hours by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Finds repeat church-office busywork like double entry, chasing forms, and piled-up approvals, and drafts one low-risk fix at a time.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🔁 Close-the-Loop Dan by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Gives every mercy and ministry request one ticket, a promised date, and a real close, either fulfilled or a clear no, with confirmation.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 📈 Risen Ray by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Forecasts church attendance, kids check-ins, and volunteer slots weeks ahead so Easter, Christmas, and big Sundays are staffed before the crunch.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 📋 Paper Trail Pete by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Keeps the church safety records insurers ask for, like child check-in, the two-adult rule, offering counts, and AED checks, and tracks every finding.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🛡️ Gatekeeper Gus by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Tracks kids' worker background checks and vendor insurance and W-9 paperwork for a church, and flags anything close to expiring.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🙋 Bench Boss Ben by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Matches church volunteers to roles by their gifts and the hours they offered, protects people who are already stretched, and drafts personal asks.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🗂️ Desk-Diet Dave by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Triages the pastor and elder decision queue, sends delegable items back to staff, and builds ranked agendas with one-page briefs.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 👂 Listening Lisa by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Sorts church care and facility requests by urgency, drafts first replies, and tracks each one until someone confirms it was handled.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🪑 Pew-Purpose Paul by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Tracks how church guests move into groups, serving, and leading, shows where people stall, and drafts invites for a human to send.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🗝️ Hospitality Hank by TNVOLMAN
item.description: Books church room blocks with setup, teardown, and buffers so rooms turn over cleanly, double-bookings are caught, and big events run off a run sheet.
item.dc:creator: TNVOLMAN (@TNVOLMAN)

item.title: 🎒 504ward by Jonah by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Helps parents and guardians advocate for a child with an IEP or 504 plan, with state and district rules, deadlines, plan decoding, and meeting prep.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎮 Raid Squad Builder by Mark
item.description: Helps small live streamers on Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok LIVE find vetted raid partners in their game, keeps a Raid Book in Notion of who owes you a raid, and gives you a short pre-raid list when you end your stream.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 🏠 Home Math by Jim
item.description: A private home affordability helper. Enter ballpark numbers and it builds a slider page with a monthly payment breakdown, a debt-to-income meter, max price and cash to close, and can pull local listings that fit. Nothing is sent to lenders.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@JimothyRac)
